teacher_reader: Original BF16 video prepare/prefill, ActionDiT and proprio encoder; no A4 or VQ in any reader operation; regenerate K/V for each donor
sampler: Optional-IDM; 9 video frames; 32x7 actions; 10 video + 10 action steps; sigma_shift=1; CPU RNG; compile=false; original observation frame0 clamp
primary_metric: first10motor_rmse; average paired seeds within case then cases equally; test n=22
claim_scope: Internal gradient/finite-perturbation diagnostic; within-codeword samples distinct from exact codebook gradients; STE backward distinct from finite BF16 forward; no proof of historical training cause or fixed-bit assignment improvement.
gradients: Separate raw action MSE and future NMSE gradients; sum repeated Linear calls per weight vector before codeword statistics. Exact full-membership codebook gradients; deterministic uniform stratified samples for within-codeword member diagnostics.
diagnostic_scope: All614 target Linears and every occupied codeword. Gradient capture uses all8 frozen calibration contexts, seed0, at all3 frozen checkpoints. No test-directed group selection. Sampled within-codeword statistics are not full-population conflict rates.
exact_selection: Action-only calibration only: choose four modules ranked by the sum of top8 book0 population-weighted sampled member-gradient energy times squared sampled cancellation; all8 cases; no test-directed selection.
intervention: No assignment implementation or new model training. Compare actual shared-codeword updates with same-support equal-decoded-weight-energy untied gradient diagnostic and random-direction control, at two frozen step norms. Untied intervention is a capacity-relaxation diagnostic, not a valid compressed model.
intervention_cohort: All60 original contexts, paired seeds; fixed BF16 teacher-reader future evaluation and native actions; no executed episodes.
progression_rule: At both frozen step norms: untied mean future NMSE lower than shared on calibration and test; improves at least12/22 test cases in future NMSE; fixed-teacher first10 motor mean no worse; test future NMSE better than equal-energy random. Engineering rule only, not significance or fixed-bit method validation.
